scope: Cross-session experiment reservations. Exact (AXIS, value) reuse is prohibited. Numeric PRUNE cutoffs with any refill policy are treated as occupied, a stricter rule than literal string matching. The MASS block below lists every MASS value already BUILT by the five sibling sessions that were fetched on 2026-10-23, so the shadow doses stay distinguishable by value and by mechanism.

mass_axis.why_distinct: Every sibling MASS value changes the count by a round percentage using the parent's stored 8-connected FIFO-BFS order or a plain 'lowest rank' truncation. The selected values use a different ranking (ascending exclusive 300 m kernel credit, recomputed after each deletion) and are the only MASS doses that delete dots without adding or moving any. The recorded values are exact string labels and do not collide; the 30% dose is also a magnitude no sibling built.
mass_axis.matched_count_check: At the same 3,765 removals the shadow order destroys 35% less exclusive kernel credit than the stored FIFO order (see evidence/mass_build_receipt.json ranking.matched_count_comparison_at_10pct). The sibling 10% doses therefore are not the same experiment.

mass_high_dose.cross_repo_caveat: This is a best-effort audit of public repositories, not proof of every submission the entity has ever made. If any sibling repository is the same DrivenData entity, the campaign as a whole exceeds the 3-scored-submissions-per-week quota; see IRREGULARITIES IR90-08.
mass_high_dose.rejection_reason: Built/probed once on 2026-10-23 and rejected before any submission, rasters and ledger rows removed: (a) fifo 10/20/40% -- the parent's stored 8-connected FIFO-BFS order deletes one south-east corner; at 40% it empties 41% of 5 km blocks in a single contiguous 632-block hole, i.e. a region-isolated file under Hard Constraint #5 that confounds dose with geography; (b) shadow 50% -- the deepest shadow dose starts emptying whole contiguous regions (largest emptied cluster 17 blocks = 425 km2). The deep arm therefore stops at 48%, the largest shadow dose whose candidate passes the region-evenness gate. The same FIFO defect applies to any sibling MASS dose built with that stored order.
